title: Caring for dental implants
what: An implant cannot get cavities, but the gum around it can become inflamed. Here is how to care for it every day.
why: For everyone who has dental implants - with a crown, bridge or denture.
duration: usually 3 to 5 minutes morning and evening
tell_doctor: If the gum around the implant bleeds, turns red or hurts

prepare.title: Toothbrush
prepare.text: A soft brush, sometimes a single-tuft brush for the area near the gum.

prepare.title: Between teeth
prepare.text: Interdental brushes, special floss or a water flosser. Your dentist will tell you what suits you.

bring: A water flosser, if your dentist advised it
steps: Brush your teeth and the implant crown with a soft brush
Pay attention to the place where the crown meets the gum
Pass an interdental brush between the implant and the neighboring teeth
Under a bridge or denture, use floss or a water flosser
feel: A little blood in the first days is common - if it does not stop, see your dentist
after: Professional cleaning at the dentist follows your dentist's schedule, usually once or twice a year
Do not bite hard things: nuts, ice
If you grind your teeth, ask your dentist about a night guard
red_flags: Pus, swelling or pain around the implant
The crown or implant is loose - book a visit with your dentist

faq.q: How long does an implant last?
faq.a: Usually many years. What matters is care at home and regular check-ups.

faq.q: Can I use an electric toothbrush?
faq.a: Usually yes, with a soft head.

reminders.text: Before bed, clean your implants: brush, interdental brush or water flosser.
